newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: KLM to pay NLG 46.281 each for govt shares.
newsitem.headline: KLM to pay NLG 46.281 each for govt shares.

text.p: KLM Royal Dutch Airlines said on Monday it would pay 46.2810 guilders per share for the 17.29 million ordinary KLM shares it is buying back from the Dutch government.
KLM and the government announced the share buy-back deal, which will cut the government's stake in the airline to 25 pct from 38 pct, on December 5.
KLM to pay NLG 46.281 each for govt =2
The airline said it would pay a total of 800.2 million guilders ($458.5 million) to the government for the ordinary shares and make an additional payment of 176.3 million guilders to the state.

The additional payment represents an amount of 15 guilders per share for a reduction in the nominal value of the 11.75 million "A" preference shares held by the government as part of the buy-back agreement. ($ = 1.745 Dutch Guilders)
